description: Calculate the total cost of hiring someone in a specific country through Deel EOR. Use when the user asks "how much would it cost to hire in [country]?" or about employment costs abroad.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

country.description: Full country name (e.g., "Portugal", "Germany", "Ireland"). Must be the full name, not a code.

salary.description: Annual gross salary in the country's currency

name: deel_calculate_employment_cost
title: Deel Calculate Employment Cost
